item.title: Iran warns US forces as oil tankers damaged and possible attack looms
item.description: Iran is bracing for a possible new wave of US and Israeli strikes after the US midterm elections on November 3 and Israel's election on October 27, according to Iranian officials and media reports. item.title: Moderna-Merck personalized mRNA cancer vaccine reduces melanoma recurrence risk by 42% in pivotal trial
item.description: A large Phase 3 clinical trial testing a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine from Moderna and Merck has shown that the vaccine, in combination with the immunotherapy drug pembrolizumab (Keytruda), reduced the risk of melanoma recurrence or death by 42% compared with pembrolizumab alone over a median…
